about: The Workbench icons of the OpenLieroX drawer: python3 /mnt/amigachrome/team2/tools/amicradle/scripts/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons. The art (art/openlierox.svg, drawn as an OS 3.5 GlowIcon: shaped, shaded, see-through round the edges) is The AmiCradle Team's own, under the same terms as the other Amiga files; art/openlierox.png is it rendered at 128 x 128. OpenLieroX-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, OpenLieroX.info beside the drawer; it has its own name here so as not to meet the program's OpenLieroX.info.
